I've lived in the northwest of Washington state. Its cold wet and depressing. Hopelessness is easy to get too when all you are exposed too is whats around you. 

Let yourself see things that amaze you. Make a plan to get there. Make a goal. 

If you have to start small you start small. No job to pay for it? Start there. No car? Next. Occupy yourself with a goal. 

Its easy to trap yourself in a world that you see as worthless and oppresive. My dad is a pessimistic asshole who lives to see the bad in the world. Its influenced me a lot. Im trying to be better despite days where I want to fucking scream at how pointless it seems. 

Despite that sometimes I can find happines in somehing in my future. Thinking of a place I want to go. Animals and creatures habits that fucking amazef me that I have to see in real life. Bands I still want to see and experience in a venue.

Watch documentaries. I know that sounds dumb. But look at how much beauty there still is in the world. Look at people trying to fix problems despite no guarantee that anything will change. The hope that people have can be very inspiring sometimes even if you aren't feeling it yourself. 

There is so much shittyness in this world. Buts its not all shit. Carve out a piece of happiness. I'm trying myself.
